title: Security for scientific and industrial Physics AI (`pinneapple_security`)
description: Secure Physics AI pipeline, end to end, with pinneapple_security. A plant shares 30 days of operating data (flow in, flow out, pump speed) to train a surrogate of the outlet flow. The data is confidential and holds operator e-mails in a notes column.
